usage: The word '武術' (mou5 seot6) is a noun and refers to martial arts.
'武術' can be used as the subject or object in a sentence.
When talking about learning or practicing martial arts, '武術' is commonly used.
It can describe different styles or categories under martial arts, like kung fu or tai chi.
'武術' can also be combined with verbs like '學' (to learn) or '練' (to practice) to talk about training.
